name: JSON Schema & Structured Extraction
description: Tests models on adhering strictly to required JSON object formats with field constraints.

cases.prompt: Extract the person information from: 'Alice Chen is a 29-year-old Senior Backend Architect residing in Zurich, Switzerland.' Respond ONLY with valid JSON having keys 'name' (string), 'age' (integer), 'role' (string), 'location' (string).

Convert this product report into JSON: 'Model SKU-9901 weighs 420 grams, costs $14.99, and has 85 units left in warehouse B.' Respond ONLY with valid JSON with keys: 'sku', 'weight_grams', 'price_usd', 'stock', 'warehouse'.
